description: This file contains a shell script implementing the setup and teardown logic for an IPv4-in-IPv6 tunnel backend, specifically for map-based tunneling protocols. It defines functions for initializing configuration, setting up the map protocols, managing routing, and cleaning up.

methods.name: proto_map_setup
methods.description: Sets up the IPv4-in-IPv6 tunnel based on configuration variables, initializes routing, tunnel parameters, and firewall rules.

methods.name: proto_map_teardown
methods.description: Tears down the tunnel and associated routing and firewall configurations.

methods.name: proto_map_init_config
methods.description: Initializes configuration parameters for the map protocol, declaring the expected configuration options.
